WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.title: Wandi
WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.description:
An undying warrior of Castrum Kremnos.
He trades his own lifeblood for Vengeance, growing stronger with every wound—death itself cannot hold him.
WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.goldMonologue: Gold? A king of ruin has no need for coin... but wars are bought with something.
WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.aromaPrinciple: I am the master of my ruin. No scent commands me.
WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.cardsModifierDescript: Start the run with Wandi's deck.
WANDIMOD-WANDI_MOD.banter.alive.endTurnP: Finish it—my blood is already spent.
